rubric.role_summary: Infrastructure platform team lead combining hands-on software development with people leadership. The role builds and operates cloud infrastructure for an on-demand transit platform, with responsibility for reliability, security, and cloud cost efficiency.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Infrastructure platform team lead combining hands-on software development with people leadership. The role builds and operates cloud infrastructure for an on-demand transit platform, with responsibility for reliability, security, and cloud cost efficiency.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of software development experience, including at least 2+ years in a people leadership role.
- Backend technology expertise and strong distributed systems experience.
- Experience operating systems at scale.
- Experience with GCP and Kubernetes.
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tooling, specifically Terraform.
- Success managing a team of software developers, including team and individual performance.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in transit or another real-time, safety-critical domain.
- Experience building internal developer platforms and golden-path tooling.
- Experience applying AI/LLM tooling to SRE or infrastructure operations.
- Experience with CI/CD systems at scale, including test sharding and build performance.
- Experience operating and maintaining PostgreSQL and Redis in production.
- Demonstrated proficiency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, including AI coding agents and automation of engineering and operational tasks.
- Experience running or managing an SRE on-call rotation, including incident response and post-mortems.
- Deep experience with GCP cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes container orchestration.
- Experience driving cloud cost optimization and FinOps initiatives, including right-sizing, spend visibility, and measurable savings.
- Understanding of security best practices, especially internal access control and container security.
- Demonstrated experience mentoring developers and providing technical leadership.
- Problem-solving, debugging, and system design skills.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Vancouver, Canada area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
